decisions.reason: Because A is close to the core hosting/compliance offer, was given its own page, has several models, and even shows an early positive agency-oriented signal, management is likely to justify the invested development and keep it.

Because B was presented as a flagship and shown on the home page while directly building on the firm’s announced agency-platform direction, the firm is highly likely to stay committed rather than admit a visible strategic mistake.

Because C is also close to the established business and had enough commitment to receive its own page, management will probably continue it at this early stage and treat any weaker uptake as temporary rather than exit now.
